notes.title: "Candy Disaster" version 3.0.0 update will be available on July 27th
notes.notes:
[h1] "Candy Disaster" version 3.0.0 update will be available on July 27th[/h1]

[h2]1. Arcade Trap Pack[/h2]
The Arcade Traps Pack includes 3 traps:
[b]Gravity Magnet[/b]: (ground trap)
Release the force field to attract all enemies within a grid, gather the enemies and slow them down for a period of time.
[b]Suicide Attack[/b]: (replace trap)
If a unit (non-explosive soldier) dies within the range of the Suicide Attack, a self-destruct soldier will be recruited. The self-explosive soldiers will automatically find enemies within a certain range to launch a self-explosive Attack.
[b]Penalty Blade[/b]: (Wall Trap)
When one of your units dies on the field, fire a flying blade that deals damage equal to half the Health of the dead unit.
(Our units such as: Cold Swordsman and Sharp Shooter, Self-Destructive Soldiers)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36684116/893b86f35273282b3a131ea495747beb0df6705a.png[/img]
The three traps complete and assist each other. The Gravity Magnet will ensure that the enemies will be concentrated around the Suicide Attack battalion to be killed, and the self-explosive soldiers generated by the Suicide Attack battalion will trigger the Penalty Blade to launch flying blade. Of course, their existing traps also have many linkages. For example, flying blade can also be affected by other traps to bring attributes, and the self-destruction of self-destruct soldiers can also trigger an explosion of poison gas.

[h2]2. Daily challenge mode[/h2]
The new [b]Daily Challenge mode[/b] has been updated, and the Arcade Trap can be unlocked when player clearing the daily challenge for the first time. In the daily challenge mode, players all over the world will play the game on the map, and upload their final score on the daily ranking list. Daily challenges will also have different strings and buffs, as well as banned traps. With the blessing of the buff, the enemies on the grass may also be unable to be killed by the water just like the enemies on the snow land. Of course, buffs are not all about difficulty increases. Players will also have random enhancements. The buffs and maps of the daily challenge will change daily, guaranteeing new challenges for players every day, and at the same time giving players around the world the opportunity to compete with each other and see who is the real trap master!
